description: Den Texstraat 1-59 and 8-58 (1881-83): 5.5-6.5 m fronts of a raised ground storey and two tall upper storeys of dark brown brick; three axes (house door and two windows on the ground); white sills with a thin white sill band, small segmental arched heads on the first floor, flat heads on the second, each under a white bracket-block hood course; a heavy white entablature at 10.7-12.0 m; a short slate mansard with one white pediment dormer over the middle axis

match.note: Den Texstraat 1-59 on the 2024-12-04 strip: entablature 10.7-12.0 m, slate to 13.1 m, dormers 12.2-14.8 m; 3DBAG 4 bouwlagen (mansard counted), eaves 14.3-14.6 m

mansard-pediment-dormer.note: one white pediment dormer 1.9 m wide over the middle axis, 12.2-14.8 m, on the slate mansard

door-left.note: house door on the left axis; a pand whose door reads on the right is mirrored

roof.evidence: Den Texstraat 1-59: the black slate mansard 12.0-13.1 m behind the entablature, a steep front slope under the dormers

rhythm.roofline: heavy white entablature, slate mansard, one pediment dormer
